title: Chief AWS DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a Chief AWS DevOps Engineer to build and evolve shared AWS cloud platform services that product and application teams consume, treating the platform as a product with reusable building blocks and a consistent developer experience aligned with CCoE standards. You will shape paved roads, reliability, and secure-by-design guardrails. Responsibilities Design shared cloud platform services that application teams consume as reusable building blocks Build standard compute patterns and golden baselines to accelerate safe workload onboarding Evolve paved roads and golden paths with product teams, security, and operations Maintain centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities across the platform Implement secrets management, identity, and key management integrations as platform primitives Partner with DevOps and IaC teams to codify platform interfaces in Terraform and pipelines Improve platform reliability, scalability, resilience, and developer experience continuously Align platform capabilities with security, compliance, and enterprise architecture guardrails Represent internal developer teams to prioritize platform roadmap and lifecycle investments Support centralized integrations such as file transfers and federation where required Requirements 7+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience with a product/platform mindset Deep AWS compute, storage, networking, and managed services experience Strong shared-services architecture background for logging, monitoring, secrets, and identity Proven security-by-design practices knowledge including IAM roles and policy-as-code Platform interface and API definition experience for internal developer consumption Strong stakeholder communication skills with a client-centric mindset Upper-Intermediate English proficiency (B2) Nice to have AWS IAM expertise for role design and federation patterns AWS Networking and Content Delivery knowledge for scalable, secure traffic patterns AWS Storage Gateway experience for hybrid storage integrations AWS Compute depth across EC2, ECS, EKS, and Lambda Security by Design Principles applied to cloud platform guardrails We offer International projects with top brands Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers Healthcare benefits Employee financial programs Paid time off and sick leave Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses Global career opportunities Volunteer and community involvement opportunities EPAM Employee Groups Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
